properties.title: Glider CHLA profile metrics (0–200 m, 10 m bins) with OLCI matchups
properties.description:
CHLA metrics from 280 IOOS Glider DAC deployments (Slocum, Spray and Seagliders; Mar 2024–Oct 2026; US East and West coasts, British Columbia, Gulf of Alaska, Irminger Sea, Bermuda, Great Lakes, Antarctic Peninsula; column region), chosen by a scan of every DAC chlorophyll deployment, one row per deployment and 3 h window of local solar time keeping one glider profile per window, depth-binned 0–200 m in 10 m bins (A < depth <= B) from samples passing the dataset's QC flag, and divided by the Sauzède et al. fluorescence:chlorophyll ratio (column chla_ratio), as for OOI. The raw fluorometer bins (CHLA_FLUOR_A_B) and a deep (dark) offset (dark_offset, not subtracted) are kept as columns. QC columns from the scan: deep_offset_flag (True for deployments reading > 0.2 below 300 m, mostly California Current Sprays; drop with df[~df.deep_offset_flag]) and scan_check (notes such as 'jumpy surface' or 'sparse depths', empty when the deployment passed). Windows with a whole-column sensor failure were removed. Source: IOOS Glider DAC ERDDAP. Matched to Sentinel-3 OLCI Level-3 4 km Daily Rrs (OLCIS3A_L3m_ERR_RRS, OLCIS3B_L3m_ERR_RRS; 11 bands 400–709 nm) for every profile on a day with an OLCI file (to 2026-10-01): the file of the profile's UTC day, nearest 4 km cell, S3A first then S3B. Columns pace_granule and pace_Rrs_valid flag whether the profile also has a PACE match, so OLCI can be compared with PACE on the same profiles or used on its own. OLCI Rrs is NaN where the pixel was masked.

How to load

ASSET_URL use 'Copy URL' on left

Python df = pandas.read_parquet('ASSET_URL')

R  df <- arrow::read_parquet('ASSET_URL')
properties.platform: IOOS Glider DAC gliders (Slocum, Spray, Seaglider)
